rows.ARS:
Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MEInimo
Exhibition name: Regatta (hybrid tea, Meilland, 1990)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 1990).
Introduced in Switzerland by Hauenstein AG in 1990 as 'Nella Martinetti'.
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) in 1994 as '21 Again!'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink, salmon-pink shading, pink reverse. [Salmon-pink, lighter reverse.] Strong, raspberry, spice fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 2.75". Medium, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped, flat, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, armed with thorns / prickles, bushy, upright. Large, matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 4' (60 to 120cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
